findings.title: Do not claim a fixed game.cfg is necessary or RANDOM always refuses
findings.evidence: The document itself correctly identifies the campaign-file rain-tag0 init_fixed(DRY) path and says that each compatible fixed request enters STATIC. In source parsgen.c1318 that request sets the mirror to the planned F(DRY). Later sparm_sc.c1500-1508 invokes init_random for SESSION_WEATHER_RANDOM only while local_weather_model remainsTRUE. After the earlier fixed request it isFALSE, so a missing/default-RANDOM game.cfg causes no second random request. With authored M=DRY, the proposed provider table reachesSTATIC and accepts this boot, contrary to the later unconditional sentence that missing game.cfg or RANDOM ends in refusal. The provider receives init_fixed(mode), not which file/config path caused it, so its current proposed state machine cannot enforce the stated binary-config prerequisite.
findings.required_correction: State the actual restriction in terms of observed request sequence: a compatible fixed request may come from the campaign rain tag or from configured GOOD/FAIR/POOR; RANDOM/missing game.cfg fails only when no earlier compatible fixed request occurred. Alternatively specify an explicit separate prevalidated configuration restriction if TL really requires it, without claiming the existing provider protocol can infer that cause. No engine/API change or runtime rerun is needed to correct this design/prose inconsistency.
